Proposed pilot: run a focused 30–45 day pilot with 8 field sales reps covering Mid‑Market East (≈50 prioritized accounts) to demonstrate a usable single customer view and visibly reduce tool‑hopping.  
Quick wins to deliver in 30–45 days: (1) a consolidated SCV dashboard showing account summary, recent interactions and open actions from CRM/email/support; (2) a one‑click “sync/update” that auto‑populates key account fields and logs changes to eliminate manual updates; (3) an in‑dashboard feedback tag button that captures structured signals.  
Feedback flow: tagged items automatically create a triage card in Product’s intake board with account context; Product PMs review weekly and either route to backlog, research, or close with rationale (pilot will track triage time and roadmap‑relevant signals).  
Minimum compliance safeguards: strict role‑based access limited to pilot roles (reps, sales manager, product PM, compliance), field‑level visibility rules, visible consent indicators on records, immutable audit logs for views/edits, and a limited pilot dataset with a short retention policy.  
Success metrics & asks: targets—30% fewer tool switches, 25% less manual update time, ≥20 tagged feedback items; please confirm pilot reps/region, any mandated tooling, and the legal/compliance reviewer to sign off before the sponsor huddle.
